note: 12-part rubric for an X profile, 100 points. The profile answers one question in about three seconds: is this account worth following? It's read from a reply or a repost, on a phone, so it's the name, bio, header and pinned post that decide.

items.label: Display name
items.full_marks: Real name, or name + one short descriptor people search for (e.g. 'Alok | building games in public'). Readable in a reply.
items.zero: Handle repeated, emoji wall, or a name nobody could find.

items.label: Handle
items.full_marks: Easy to say and type. Matches the name or the user's handle elsewhere (GitHub, LinkedIn).
items.zero: Random digits that look like a bot. Note the cost of changing it (links and mentions break) before recommending a change.

items.label: Profile photo
items.full_marks: A clear face, tightly cropped, high contrast, recognisable at 40px in a reply.
items.zero: Default egg/silhouette, a logo for a personal account, or a far-away photo.

items.label: Header image
items.full_marks: One line of what you build or do, plus proof or a handle, in the safe centre area. Or a real screenshot of the thing.

items.label: Bio: what you do
items.full_marks: Says what you build or do, and for whom, in plain words. Someone who reads only this knows why to follow.
items.zero: 'Passionate about tech', 'Learner', 'Dreamer', or a list of 6 roles.

items.label: Bio: proof
items.full_marks: One concrete proof: a thing shipped, a result with a number, a place. Something checkable.
items.zero: No proof, or claims with no anchor ('top developer', 'AI expert').

items.label: Bio: sounds like a person
items.full_marks: Reads like the user talks. At most one emoji. No hashtag wall. 'Views my own' is optional, not a substitute.
items.zero: A wall of hashtags, emoji separators between buzzwords, or third-person corporate copy.

items.label: Website link
items.full_marks: The one place to send a new follower: portfolio, GitHub, or the project. It works and loads fast on mobile.
items.zero: Empty, broken, or a link-in-bio page with 15 dead links.

items.label: Location
items.full_marks: A real city or region (helps local recruiters and peers). A short joke is fine if the city is in the bio.
items.zero: Empty when location matters to the user's goals (hiring, local events).

items.label: Pinned post
items.full_marks: The best answer to 'why follow?': the best-performing post, or an intro thread (who, what I'm building, what I post). Recent enough to be true.
items.zero: Nothing pinned, or a stale post about something the user no longer does.

items.label: Last 10 posts
items.full_marks: Match the bio's promise. Mostly the user's own posts and takes, posted regularly, with real replies.
items.zero: Only reposts, only recaps, or nothing in weeks.

items.label: Replies tab
items.full_marks: Specific, useful replies to people in the niche. This is where curious people check whether you're real.
items.zero: Empty, or 'Great post!' and emoji replies.
